Technical SEO.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Is Rolling Out
Technical SEO.summary: Google officially began rolling out its November 2026 core update, which is expected to take approximately two weeks to complete. Google described it as a regular update designed to better surface relevant and satisfying content for searchers from all types of sites.

Technical SEO.title: Google AI Overview Local Pack Dropping Action Buttons, Photos & Reviews
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing the removal of action buttons, reviews, and photos from the AI Overview version of the local pack, making it harder for searchers to visit websites, call businesses, or get directions directly from search results. This change has significant implications for local and enterprise brands relying on local pack visibility.

Technical SEO.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Available In Google Search AI Mode
Technical SEO.summary: Google has made Gemini 4 Carbon, described as its strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic workflows, available in Google Search via AI Mode for subscribers. The model's integration into Search AI Mode signals continued evolution of the AI-powered search experience.

Technical SEO.title: Google: It Can Take Time To Understand The Unique Value Of New Websites
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller stated on Bluesky that it can take Google Search time to understand a new site's unique value and rank it accordingly, noting that the systems need time to process content on newer sites that have been actively publishing. This is relevant context for enterprise site launches, migrations, or new subdomain strategies.

Technical SEO.title: Good Vs. Bad pSEO: Learnings From A Decade Of Building Scalable Content Engines
Technical SEO.summary: The article argues that programmatic SEO pages must earn their place through unique data, clear publishing standards, and pruning rules to prevent scale from becoming spam. This is directly applicable to enterprise travel and automotive sites running large-scale destination or inventory pages.

Technical SEO.title: Google's Custom Search JSON API Ends January 1, 2027
Technical SEO.summary: Google's Custom Search JSON API is set to shut down on January 1, 2027, which will affect any enterprise tools or workflows that rely on it for crawling, indexation monitoring, or search data retrieval. Teams dependent on this API will need to plan migration before year end.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Expands Ads In AI Mode To 10+ Countries, Adds Multiturn Ads
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google is rolling out English-language ads in AI Mode to more than 10 new countries and launching multiturn ads that serve on follow-up queries in the US. This expansion of paid placements within AI Mode has direct implications for how organic and paid strategies interact in the AI search environment.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: The Drivers of Local AI Visibility for Multi-Location Brands by SOCi
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: SOCi examines what factors drive local AI visibility for multi-location brands as consumer AI usage grows, making visibility in AI surfaces increasingly critical. This is directly relevant to enterprise travel and automotive brands managing hundreds or thousands of local pages.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AEO Benchmarking: What Market Data Reveals About AI Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.snippet: The piece covers how marketers can measure brand AI search visibility against competitors using answer engine optimization benchmarking data.
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article covers how marketers can measure brand AI search visibility against competitors using answer engine optimization benchmarking approaches. This provides a framework for enterprise teams tracking share of voice in AI answer surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Starts Rolling Out
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Search Engine Journal confirms Google has begun rolling out its November 2026 core update globally, with completion expected within two weeks. Covered here as the SEJ version for teams who prefer that source; the Roundtable version is the primary record in the Technical SEO category.

AI Search / GEO.title: Businesses in ChatGPT Business Hub Live With Click Data
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI has launched the ChatGPT Business Hub, which provides businesses with analytics on mentions, profile views, and clicks to their websites originating from ChatGPT. This is a significant development for GEO practitioners who now have a native measurement surface for AI-driven referral traffic.

AI Search / GEO.title: Where Does ChatGPT Get Its Information? 4 Sources, Explained
AI Search / GEO.summary: Ahrefs explains the four sources ChatGPT draws from: training data, live web searches, licensed publisher content, and user-provided context. Understanding these sourcing mechanisms is foundational for enterprise teams building GEO strategies to appear in ChatGPT answers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode for Subscribers Gains Gemini 4 Carbon
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land confirms that Google AI Mode for subscribers now runs on Gemini 4 Carbon, the company's latest frontier model. This model upgrade affects how AI Mode generates and surfaces answers, with potential downstream effects on which content gets cited.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google's Core Update Shifts Rankings for Up to 2 Weeks Before Black Friday
AI Search / GEO.summary: The November 2026 core update's two-week rollout window lands directly before Black Friday, meaning ranking volatility could coincide with one of the highest-stakes organic traffic periods for travel and retail enterprises. Teams should monitor ranking stability closely during the rollout.

AI Search / GEO.title: Yahoo is Betting the House on Its New AI, From Search to All Its Services
AI Search / GEO.summary: Fast Company reports that Yahoo is making AI central to its search and broader service offerings, with Yahoo Scout moving out of beta and Pivot Search launching as a new feature. As an emerging AI search surface, Yahoo Scout is worth monitoring for enterprise brands building multi-platform GEO coverage.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Rolling Out Now
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land confirms the November 2026 core update is now rolling out, providing an authoritative secondary source for teams tracking the update across multiple intelligence feeds. The update's proximity to peak travel and retail booking season makes it especially relevant for cruise and automotive verticals.
